items.example: I have a meeting at two.
items.simple: A time when people come to one room to talk.

items.example: She’s a colleague from my team.
items.simple: A person who works in the same place as you.

items.example: My boss is on holiday.
items.simple: The person who tells you what to do at work.

items.example: We have a tight deadline.
items.exampleTr: Çok sıkışık bir teslim tarihimiz var.
items.simple: The last day you can finish a thing.

items.example: The deadline is on Friday.
items.simple: You say which day you must finish.

items.example: My schedule is full today.
items.simple: A list that says what you do and when.

items.example: I have three tasks to finish.
items.simple: A small job you need to do.

items.example: We’re working on a new project.
items.simple: A big job that takes many days.

items.example: I’m writing a report for my manager.
items.simple: Papers or words that tell what happened.

items.example: Her presentation was really good.
items.simple: You stand and tell many people about something.

items.example: We have a call with a client.
items.simple: A person who gives money to get your help at work.

items.example: Are you available tomorrow?
items.simple: You can come, because you are not busy.

items.example: Are you free at three for a quick chat?
items.exampleTr: Kısa bir sohbet için saat üçte boş musun?
items.simple: You ask if a person is not busy at three o'clock.

items.example: Everyone's here. Let's get started.
items.simple: We start now.

items.example: That's all from me. Any questions?
items.exampleTr: Benden bu kadar. Sormak istediğiniz var mı?
items.simple: You ask if people want to ask something.

items.en: Let me get back to you.
items.example: I’m not sure. Let me get back to you.
items.simple: I will think and tell you after.
items.note: Hemen cevap veremediğinde çok işe yarar.

items.tr: Ertelesek / başka bir zamana alsak olur mu?
items.example: Sorry, can we reschedule the meeting?
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, toplantıyı başka bir zamana alabilir miyiz?
items.simple: You ask to change the day or time for later.

items.example: Can you set up a meeting for Monday?
items.exampleTr: Pazartesi için bir toplantı ayarlayabilir misin?
items.simple: You make it ready, so it can begin.

items.example: Let’s go over the report together.
items.simple: You look at it again, from start to end.

items.example: Let’s catch up after the meeting.
items.simple: You talk to a person to hear what is new.

items.example: I’ll sort it out this afternoon.
items.simple: You fix a thing that is not good.

items.example: I did two hours of overtime.
items.simple: Work you do after your normal time at work.
